GSCF | http://www.gscf.com/ About Us: GSCF is the leading global provider of working capital solutions. The Company enables corporates and financial partners to accelerate growth, unlock liquidity and manage the risk and complexity of the end-to-end working capital cycle. We originate, manage and analyze working capital programs through our innovative Working Capital as a Service offering, combining the power of a configurable and comprehensive technology platform, expert services and a Connected Capital ecosystem of alternative capital solutions and bank capital. GSCF’s team of working capital experts operates in over 75 countries to solve global working capital efficiency challenges. Visit www.gscf.com to learn more. Role Summary: The Analyst, Financial Operations is responsible for supporting the financial and operational oversight of assigned programs, ensuring accurate and efficient execution of transactions, strong financial controls , and high-quality service delivery. The role is focused on monitoring program performance, managing operational risk, and supporting financial exceptions across client programs. How You Will Make an Impact: Program Execution & Financial Oversight Manage daily operational and financial activities within assigned program(s) Ensure accurate processing of transactions, including validations, reconciliations, and exception handling Monitor operational flows within programs to ensure alignment with contractual terms and operational guidelines Perform regular reconciliations across program data, transaction records, and system outputs Identify and investigate discrepancies, breaks, or inconsistencies in transactional data Support resolution of issues in coordination with internal teams (Legal, Capital Markets, Finance, Technology) Maintain audit-ready documentation of all activities Risk Management & Controls Identify, assess, and escalate risks within assigned programs, proactively highlight exceptions, unusual trends, or potential exposures Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, and regulatory requirements Reporting & Analytics Prepare regular and ad hoc reporting on program performance, volumes, and financial metrics Support stakeholders with data-driven insights to improve decision-making Stakeholder & Client Coordination Act as a key point of contact for all program-related queries Coordinate actions and exceptions with internal and external stakeholders Support communication of program updates, performance, and issue resolution Systems & Data Integrity Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) for system changes affecting financial data and processes Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, and data accuracy Ensure accurate system configuration and usage aligned with program requirements Support data integrity controls across systems and reporting frameworks What You Bring to the Team: Required Skills & Experience 2–4 years of experience in operations, financial operations, or a related analytical role Strong understanding of financial processes (reconciliation, controls, transaction flows) Advanced Excel skills ; experience with financial data analysis and reporting, interest calculation, and reports validation. High attention to detail and ability to work with complex datasets Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Excellent spoken and written English skills Italian or Spanish language knowledge is a plus Key Competencies Financial acumen and analytical thinking Strong control and risk awareness mindset Attention to detail and accuracy Stakeholder collaboration and communication Process improvement orientation All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by law. Privacy Notice Please note that your personal data will be processed in accordance with GSCF Privacy Notice for Job Candidates. When submitting your application, you therefore acknowledge and confirm that you understand that your personal data will be processed in accordance with the above-mentioned Privacy Notice. Should you have any questions regarding the processing of your personal data by GSCF, please contact us at: privacy@gscf.com.

All of this is thanks to our passion for innovation and the use of modern technologies. We operate globally, partnering with thousands of marketplaces and industry leaders such as Amazon, eBay, Shopify, DHL, and FedEx , and our international team of experts works in Poland, Europe, the Americas, and Asia. We are proud of our spectacular growth - we're more than just another tech company. As one of the fastest-growing platforms in the industry, we've seen dynamic growth over the past three years, expanding our revenue and our global customer base. We are building a culture centered on real impact and collaboration, because our team is the heart of our innovation We're already working in the market, building relationships across the ecommerce ecosystem and growing our UK customer base. Now we're investing in the next stage of that journey and we're looking for an ambitious Account Executive to help accelerate it. This gives you the best of both worlds. You'll join a proven international technology company with an established platform, global customers, significant integrations and experienced teams behind you while still having the opportunity to influence how we scale o 🚀 The opportunity As an Account Executive, you'll own the full new-business sales cycle across the UK & Ireland. You'll work with scaling brands, retailers and ecommerce businesses, engaging Heads of Ecommerce, Marketplace, Operations and senior leadership to understand where operational complexity is limiting growth. From there, you'll demonstrate how Base can help them scale. Requirements You're an experienced B2B SaaS Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, navigate complex sales cycles and close new business. We're looking for: 3-5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience A strong record of achieving or exceeding quota Full-cycle new-logo sales experience Excellent discovery, demonstration, negotiation and closing skills Confidence engaging senior decision-makers Experience navigating multi-stakeholder sales Strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline A proactive, commercially curious and high-agency mindset Experience across ecommerce, retail technology, marketplaces, fulfilment, WMS, OMS or supply-chain technology would be a major advantage. But deep ecommerce experience isn't our only route to a great hire. If you're an exceptional SaaS seller with the curiosity and capability to quickly learn the ecommerce ecosystem, we want to hear from you. Responsibilities As an Account Executive you'll: Win strategic new-logo customers across the UK & Ireland Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of target accounts Run consultative discovery and value-led product demonstrations Develop commercial business cases linked to measurable customer outcomes Manage multi-stakeholder opportunities from first conversation through to close Build relationships across our agency, 3PL, marketplace and technology ecosystem Work closely with Marketing, Partnerships, Implementation, KAM and Product Bring market insight that helps us continually strengthen our UK GTM strategy Benefits Why Base? Established business. Growth-stage opportunity. We're not asking you to join an unknown startup and prove the concept. Base already operates globally with an established technology platform and customer ecosystem. Your opportunity is to help accelerate our next phase of UK growth. Make an impact. The UK organisation is growing, which means your ideas, customer insight and market knowledge can genuinely influence how we develop. Sell something that solves real complexity. As ecommerce businesses expand across marketplaces, warehouses, countries and fulfillment partners, their operations become increasingly difficult to manage. Base exists to simplify that complexity. Global capability behind you. You'll have the technology, product expertise, international experience and wider organisation of an established global business supporting you. Strong earning potential. Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and accelerators for over-performance. Career runway. We're investing in the UK for the long term. As the organisation grows, we want the people driving that growth to develop with it. What we offer 🏠 Hybrid working centred around our Brighton office 💰 Competitive base + uncapped commission and accelerators 🏥 Private medical insurance & wellbeing support 📈 Clear career progression 🌍 International environment and global exposure 🤝 Collaborative UK and international teams 🎯 The opportunity to directly influence our UK&Ireland growth
